invented_facts: The Aurora 14 delivers desktop-level power and solves the need for massive data center infrastructure.
The processor handles demanding engineering tasks without draining the battery.
The GPU renders complex simulations and 3D models without stuttering, and ensures hardware does not become a workflow bottleneck.
Storage is user-upgradeable; the sheet specifies two M.2 slots but explicitly confirms user upgradeability only for memory.
The display ensures accurate color representation; the sheet specifies gamut coverage, not color accuracy.
The starting price is a competitive entry point.
